subject: MedTech Labs - Request for one-time deep discount & packaging change (CFO sign-off)
messages:
From: Harper Lin <harper.lin@medtechlabs.com>
To: michael_grant@redwood.com
Cc: Asha Patel <asha.patel@medtechlabs.com>, procurement@medtechlabs.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal revision + ask for onboarding pricing concession

Michael —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We’re excited about the latency advantages your runtime showed on our test set. I’ve shared the technical notes with our infra team.

Commercially: given this pilot will touch 3 regulated environments and we intend to commit to a 24‑month ramp (pilot -> prod -> enterprise), our CFO is asking if you can provide a one‑time deep onboarding discount (40% off month 1-3 billable tokens) and waive the Dedicated deployment setup fee. We understand this is outside standard guardrails.

Can you escalate for an internal exec signoff? We’d like a short approval packet (one page) that we can show our CFO by next Tuesday.

Attachments: initial_requirements.xlsx (reference only)

Best,
Harper
Director, Product
MedTech Labs
From: michael_grant@redwood.com
To: Harper Lin <harper.lin@medtechlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal revision + ask for onboarding pricing concession

Harper —

Appreciate the context and the timeline. I’m looping in our commercial and finance leads to evaluate. Quick note on constraints: 40% across three months is steeper than our normal one‑time onboarding credit. If we can agree to a committed monthly minimum starting month 4 and a 24‑month annualized commit, I think we have flexibility to structure a staged concession.

I’m copying: Marissa (sales lead), Kimberly (finance), Markus (solutions lead), Laura (revops) to prepare a concise approval packet for your CFO. We’ll include: proposed schedule of changes, revenue protection clauses, and a one‑page risk/mitigation memo.

I’ll follow up with draft by EOD Thursday.

Thanks,
Mike Grant
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: none
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: michael_grant@redwood.com; kimberly_park@redwood.com; markus_klein@redwood.com; laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 14:31:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: MedTech Labs - escalation packet draft request

Team —

Forwarding Harper’s ask. Summary of proposed structure (draft below):

- One‑time onboarding credit: Equivalent to 40% off for first 3 months, offset over year 1 (i.e., credit applied upfront; clawback if commit not met).
- Dedicated deployment setup fee: waived, but we require a 12‑month minimum for Dedicated for provisioning windows.
- Minimum committed spend: $45k/month starting month 4 for months 4–24, with quarterly true‑ups.
- Contractual protections: revenue clawback if cancellation within 12 months of dedicated provisioning; benchmarked usage floors; pass‑throughs for additional region provisioning.

Key asks for docs: Kimberly — need finance view on acceptable clawback terms and guardrail thresholds; Mark — confirm technics on dedicated provisioning window and earliest start date; Laura — prepare an exec one‑pager and HubSpot deal update (deal D-98742).

Attached: discount_tables.xlsx (worked examples) and redlines_contract.docx (placeholder).

marissa
VP, Sales Operations

Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: RE: MedTech Labs - internal approval packet (CFO signoff)

Marissa / team —

Finance view and recommended approval path below.

1) Approve conditional deep onboarding credit equivalent to 38% for months 1–3 (slightly reduced from request) if the following are contractually guaranteed:
   - $45k/month committed floor from month 4 through month 24 (as proposed)
   - 12‑month clawback window after Dedicated provisioning (prorated on time remaining)
   - Usage reporting dashboard enabled with 30‑day cadence for first 6 months

2) Waive Dedicated setup fee once the signed SOW and payment terms are in place; require provisioning to begin within 60 days of contract execution.

3) Contract addendum: automatic reversion to list pricing if committed floor is missed for two consecutive quarters; provide a one‑time grace quarter for migration.

I’ve attached a short one‑pager (executive packet) and updated discount table that shows net impact to ARR and present value. Harper — I’ll prepare language we can include for your CFO slide so this is clear and defensible.

Please find attached: MTL_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW draft), discount_tables.xlsx (updated).

Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Finance | Redwood Inference
Attachments: MTL_SOW_v3.pdf, discount_tables.xlsx
